en: Old sepia-toned industrial scene showing a large factory complex with multiple tall chimneys emitting smoke, surrounded by buildings and bare trees. Below the image is printed text in Hungarian, with additional handwritten message and a date noting Pécs 1903. The reverse side bears the printed heading 'LEVELEZŐ-LAP', address lines, a Hungarian postage stamp cancelled in Pécs, and handwritten recipient details.
